title: Cancel renewal or keep your subscription
summary: Schedule cancellation for the end of the paid term, or reverse it before that date.

sections.title: Stop the next renewal
sections.body:
1. Open **Subscription & billing → Overview**.
2. Select **Cancel subscription** when available for your active subscription.
3. Read the displayed paid-term end date. Choose an optional **Reason**.
4. Select **Cancel at renewal** to confirm, or **Keep subscription** to leave the dialog without cancelling.
5. Check the saved cancellation date and subscription state.

sections.title: Keep a scheduled-to-cancel subscription
sections.body: Before the paid term ends, use **Keep subscription** on Overview. Verify the state updates. After the subscription has ended, starting a new subscription is required instead of reversing the old cancellation.

sections.title: What cancellation means
sections.body: Renewal stops at the end of the paid term. Existing unpaid invoices still need payment. Your business records remain stored under the applicable retention policy; cancellation does not delete your account or erase financial history. Cancellation is not a confirmation that a refund was issued.

sections.title: If the action is unavailable
sections.body: The action requires subscription-management permission and an eligible subscription state. If payment status is uncertain, resolve it through the billing recovery notice. For a specific refund or closure request, contact support with the relevant invoice and safe reference rather than deleting your sign-in account.
